title: the MM2 letter D part 3 - the devil section
audit_comment: THE MM2 LETTER D PART 3 - the devil section of the Monster Manual II arc (the user Go call on the landed deva turn). The pin-time walk from the print finds THIRTEEN entries on pp. 44-49: the abishai five-form table and the Amon, Bael, bearded devil, Belial, Glasya, Hutijin, Mammon, Mephistopheles, Moloch, nupperibo, Titivilus and spined devil blocks. SEVENTEEN defs ride the R791 data_files extension in the MM1 registry schema (the abishai splits five ways, the aspis precedent). THE GRIDS: the 17-row DevStats stat grid, the 9x12 Frequency of Devils on Plane grid and the 9x12 Frequency of Others on Plane grid (the letter-code legend 0 absent, 1 VVR, 2 VR, 3 R, 4 U, 5 C). THE SETTLED READS: the Titivilus symbol 99 hit points (the capture 98 misread); the Titivilus MOVE 15/30 MC:D; the Mephistopheles rulership print typo verbatim; the abishai command; the nupperibo Standard magic-resistance word; the single stench kow frequency column. NO GAP FLIPS (the Letter D box flips only when all the D parts land - the R791 no-flip precedent). NO XP-AUDIT PATCH (mm2_print rides the allowed-source list since R797). The live def walk (the one file-patch site block, no census marker) cross-checks all 17 defs against the DevStats grid, the loader attack semantics, the nupperibo Standard word and the registry census floor 566 -> 583.

banner.title: THE MM2 LETTER D PART 3 - the devil section (the DEVIL family pp. 44-49: the abishai five-form table and the Amon through spined devil stat blocks), promoted to the live registry
banner.provenance: Round five of the MM2 arc, the third PART-LETTER walk (the user Go call on the landed deva turn: the letter D continues with the devil section pp. 44-49; the DIAKK turn and the rest of D await the user call). The capture is the Curtiss PDF upload cross-checked against an independent transcription and the archive.org djvu OCR, the contested cells settled: the Titivilus symbol prints 19 levels or hit dice or 99 hit points (the capture 98 is an OCR misread; the transcription and the djvu print 99); the Titivilus MOVE prints 15/30 MC:D (the djvu agrees; the transcription 12 token is its own annotation); the Mephistopheles spell list prints rulership once per day - the print typo pins verbatim (the capture and the djvu agree); the abishai spell list prints command (the capture c-command is an OCR artifact); the nupperibo MAGIC RESISTANCE prints the word Standard (the grid reads 0, the charon Nil precedent applied to the word); the Stench Kow frequency column is a single column (the capture table-split introduced a phantom blank column; the djvu corroborates). The pin-time walk finds thirteen devil stat-block entries - the abishai table splits five ways (the aspis precedent) - so seventeen .lua defs ride the R791 data_files extension, registry 566 -> 583. The stat blocks pin in the 17-row DevStats grid; the two Frequency of Devils and Others on Plane tables pin as 9x12 letter-code grids (the legend 0 absent, 1 VVR, 2 VR, 3 R, 4 U, 5 C); the 61-line Hierarchy of the Planes of Hell roster and the devil-common doctrine (the lemure-status decades, the duke decade, the attack-form chart) pin as round-level doctrine. NO GAP FLIPS: the Letter D box flips only when all the D parts land (the R791 no-flip precedent). NO XP-AUDIT PATCH: mm2_print already rides the allowed-source list (the R797 patch). The live def walk (the one file-patch site block, no census marker) cross-checks all 17 defs against the DevStats grid, the loader attack semantics, the nupperibo Standard word and the registry census 566 -> 583 as a floor.

bools.name: mm2dfBeardedShockTroops

bools.name: mm2dfBelialRulesFourthHell

bools.name: mm2dfBelialUnholyWordOncePerDay
bools.comment: Belial can pronounce an unholy word once per day

bools.name: mm2dfBelialFearByStare
bools.comment: Belial causes fear in any individual he stares at, saving throw vs. spells applicable

bools.name: mm2dfBelialMostHandsome
bools.comment: Belial is the most handsome and diabolic in appearance of all devils, the lord of pain and sufferings

bools.name: mm2dfGlasyaConsortToMammon
bools.comment: As consort to Mammon, Glasya is one of the more powerful and influential of female devils

bools.name: mm2dfGlasyaDaughterOfAsmodeus
bools.comment: Glasya is the daughter of Asmodeus and incredibly beautiful; her wings, forked tail, horns and copper-colored skin betray her origins

bools.name: mm2dfGlasyaFingerOfDeathOncePerDay
bools.comment: Once per day Glasya can employ a finger of death

bools.name: mm2dfGlasyaDaggerOfVenom
bools.comment: Glasya carries a short sword with a poisoned blade equal to a dagger of venom

bools.name: mm2dfHutijinAristocracyOfEighthPlane
bools.comment: Hutijin commands the aristocracy of the Eighth Plane and is one of the greatest of Hell dukes

bools.name: mm2dfHutijinSymbolOfPersuasionOncePerDay
bools.comment: Hutijin can use a symbol of persuasion once per day

bools.name: mm2dfHutijinHealTwicePerDay

bools.name: mm2dfHutijinResemblesPitFiend

bools.name: mm2dfMammonRulesThirdHell
bools.comment: Mammon is the king of Hell Third Plane, a boundless series of rifts with slime streams under hot ash from spurting volcanos

bools.name: mm2dfMammonRidesNightmare
bools.comment: Mammon rides a nightmare of largest size with a pack of hell hounds at his heels, seeking trophies of the hunt

bools.name: mm2dfMammonSwordOfWounding
bools.comment: His fauchard-fork inflicts normal damage (1-8 or 1-10) but otherwise acts as a sword of wounding

bools.name: mm2dfMammonSymbolOfHopelessnessOncePerDay

bools.name: mm2dfMammonFearByGaze
bools.comment: Mammon causes fear by means of his gaze, save vs. spells applicable

bools.name: mm2dfMammonRedGold

bools.name: mm2dfMephistoRulesEighthHell

bools.name: mm2dfMephistoWrestSeventhPlane

bools.name: mm2dfMephistoWhisperingWind

bools.name: mm2dfMolochRulesSixthHell
bools.comment: Moloch is a grand duke, viceroy of Baalzebul and lord of Hell Sixth Plane

bools.name: mm2dfMolochWhipElectrical

bools.name: mm2dfMolochFlameStrikeOncePerDay

bools.name: mm2dfMolochEnmityWithGeryon

bools.name: mm2dfMolochSquareBodied

bools.name: mm2dfNupperiboHordesMarch

bools.name: mm2dfNupperiboHolyObjectBlocksRegen

bools.name: mm2dfNupperiboRemainsOfLawfulEvil

bools.name: mm2dfTitivilusMessengerForDispater

bools.name: mm2dfTitivilusFearByTouch

bools.name: mm2dfSpinedHerdLemures
